config.decision_rule: Unit = one world, paired across arms. An arm beats the baseline on a metric iff the lower bound of the 95 % paired percentile-bootstrap CI over worlds (4000 resamples) is above 0. This is a DEVELOPMENT measurement: it selects nothing, promotes no gate and is reported whatever its sign.
config.question: Gate I4 is decided: the production MCBR planner does not beat a systematic coverage sweep on this family. Before designing a V4 ranking rule, measure the ceiling. Replace the ranking rule with an evaluation-only oracle that sees truth and picks the candidate that would actually reveal most of the hidden defect, with one-step and two-step lookahead, under budgets identical to coverage's. If the ORACLE cannot beat coverage, the family has no exploitable view-selection headroom and a V4 that only re-ranks views is not worth building.
